site_dek.zh: 一个持续生长的公共数据故事书架。每份报告都保留证据、方法、交互和 QA 记录，新报告会先注册到这里，因此首页始终是统一入口。
site_dek.en: A growing public shelf for evidence-audited data stories. Each report keeps its evidence, methods, interaction, and QA visible; new reports register here first so the homepage remains the single entry point.

subtitle.zh: 精神障碍负担与照护能力的不平等
subtitle.en: Mental-disorder burden and unequal capacity to care

dek.zh: 全球精神障碍的负担有多大？真正的不平等，不只在患病率，也在资金、专业人员与社区照护能力是否跟得上需要。
dek.en: How large is the global burden of mental disorders? The sharper inequality is not only prevalence, but whether money, workforce, and community care can keep up with need.
